nodes.summary: When the left state is enumerated by the row network, the alphabet-membership condition is automatic, so the interaction recovers the source vertical-equality formula. The right state may be arbitrary because equality with an allowed left value already forces its vertical value.
nodes.title: Row interaction for enumerated left states

nodes.summary: The interaction between increasing rows is the rectangle-kernel product times vertical equality indicators. For finite alphabets, an equal vertical value contributes only when it is in `labels`.
nodes.title: Interaction between rows of the grid row network

nodes.summary: If each rectangle kernel is the finite sum of its top and bottom factors, contracting the constructed row network gives the canonical finite grid value.
nodes.title: Grid row network computes the grid value

nodes.summary: Merge every grid row into one vertex of a factored tensor network. The state and label carriers may be infinite; only the supplied alphabets are enumerated. Capacity metadata charges `L` per vertical edge and the supplied cut capacity for each active rectangle.
nodes.title: Row network of a grid tensor

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
